mapper.select: select category_id, parent_id, ancestors, category_name, order_num, status, create_time from sys_vegetable_category order by parent_id, order_num, category_id
select category_id, parent_id, ancestors, category_name, order_num, status, create_time from sys_vegetable_category where category_id = #{categoryId}
select count(1) from sys_vegetable_category where parent_id = #{categoryId}
select count(1) from sys_vegetable_category where category_id = #{candidateParentId} and find_in_set(#{categoryId}, ancestors)
select count(1) from sys_vegetable_record where category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_vegetable_category (parent_id, ancestors, category_name, order_num, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{parentId}, #{ancestors}, #{categoryName}, #{orderNum}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update sys_vegetable_category set ancestors = concat(#{newAncestors}, substring(ancestors, length(#{oldAncestors}) + 1)) where category_id != #{categoryId} and find_in_set(#{categoryId}, ancestors)
mapper.select: select records.record_id, records.category_id, records.user_id, records.planting_days, records.issue, records.create_time, records.category_name, records.user_name, records.nick_name, records.source_type, records.source_post_id from ( select r.record_id, r.category_id, r.user_id, r.planting_days, r.issue, r.create_time, c.category_name, u.user_name, u.nick_name, 'record' as source_type, null as source_post_id from sys_vegetable_record r join sys_vegetable_category c on c.category_id = r.category_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' where r.category_id in #{id} and r.user_id = #{userId} union all select 1000000000 + p.post_id as record_id, c.category_id, p.user_id, case when p.planting_time like '%以上%' then 99999 when p.planting_time regexp '^[0-9]+天$' then replace(p.planting_time, '天', '') + 0 else 0 end as planting_days, p.description as issue, coalesce(str_to_date(p.created_at, '%Y/%m/%d %H:%i'), str_to_date(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), now()) as create_time, c.category_name, u.user_name, u.nick_name, 'question' as source_type, p.post_id as source_post_id from sys_hospital_post p join sys_vegetable_category c on c.category_name = p.crop and c.status = '0' join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.user_id and u.del_flag = '0' where c.category_id in #{id} and p.user_id = #{userId} ) records order by records.record_id desc

select r.record_id, r.category_id, r.user_id, r.planting_days, r.issue, r.create_time, c.category_name, u.user_name, u.nick_name from sys_vegetable_record r join sys_vegetable_category c on c.category_id = r.category_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.user_id where r.record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_vegetable_record (category_id, user_id, planting_days, issue, create_by, create_time) values (#{categoryId}, #{userId}, #{plantingDays}, #{issue}, #{createBy}, now())
